title: Chapter 103 — Why Salespeople Need Operations Literacy
intro: The store as a system and why the best sellers understand the machine.

sections.title: Sales and Operations Are Connected
sections.content:
The best salespeople understand how the store works beyond the sales floor. They know how inventory moves, how deliveries are scheduled, how returns are processed, and how margins are calculated.

This knowledge makes them better at their job. They set accurate delivery expectations. They know what is in stock. They understand why certain products are more profitable. They coordinate with operations instead of fighting them.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating operations literacy, ask:

Does the salesperson understand the store's operational systems — or only the sales floor?
Do they set accurate expectations with customers based on operational realities?
Do they work with operations — or create problems for operations?
